candidates.title: Jacap: Robust KV Cache Eviction via Jacobian-Based Nonlinear Information Capacity Preservation
candidates.reason: softmax attentionを非線形通信channelとしてJacobian information capacityを導出し、query relevance・softmax sensitivity・structural diversityを同時に扱うKV eviction。2026-09-09新着でidentity indexに未登録。

candidates.title: ACE: Adaptive Calibration-Free Expert Skipping for MoE-based LLMs
candidates.reason: training/calibration不要でtokenごとにexpert slotをskipし、offline spectral proxyとrouter-conditioned refinementをruntime gateに統合する。MoE adaptive computationの中心テーマ。

candidates.title: Training-Free Halving of Activated Experts in Fine-Grained Mixture-of-Experts Models
candidates.reason: active expert数とrouter probability renormalization gainを分離し、Qwen fine-grained MoEでexpert compute半減時の品質劣化を大幅に抑えるtraining-free inference手法。

candidates.title: Vision Is Not Overhead: One-Pass Block Drafting for Lossless Speculative Decoding in Vision-Language Models
candidates.reason: targetのfused vision-language stateを使うone-pass block-diffusion drafterとwide-tree verificationでVLM speculative decodingをlosslessに高速化する。コード公開済み。
